title: 第11章 被施加魔法的城堡第12章 新的故事开始了
slug: 是攻略系统不是攻城略地系统
content_zh:
在带着布兰妮一起离开瑞普森林之前，布兰妮外婆特意送了一小袋子金币。
而老猎人也送过来了一匹上好的骏马。
他们心中早已笃定他必然血统高贵，都觉得一袋子金币、一匹马很难入李凯南的眼。
不过此时李凯南身边既没有扈从追随，也没有携带着包裹，或许是因为什么意外和扈从失散。
所以此时的李凯南，应该是需要这些东西的……
李凯南也是没有客套，将东西尽数收下。
他现在确实需要这些，要不然连布兰妮的薪水都提供不了。
李凯南还顺便向老猎人索要了一柄猎弓和箭矢以备不时之需，然后才领着布兰妮一起出发了。
按照老猎人的指引，李凯南一直向南便可以走出这片森林，遇到最近的一处小镇。
不过布兰妮外婆还特意提醒李凯南，在抵达小镇之后无论如何都不要靠近镇子西边的那处森林。
因为那里面，坐落着一座被女巫下了诅咒的城堡……
李凯南一听这个消息，反而有些来劲儿了。
不用说，这种被女巫诅咒的城堡一听就像是什么剧情任务或者副本！
嗯，到时候去打听一下。
如果副本等级不高的话，李凯南是肯定是要进去一趟的……
……
由于布兰妮不会骑马，离开的时候是两人共骑一匹马。
李凯南不仅会骑马，而且还很擅长！
这也属于他个人的兴趣爱好，作为胸无大志富二代的他在穿越之前，甚至还养了三匹马专门用来供他练习马战和马上骑射……
所以哪怕是带着布兰妮，他驾驭马匹也显得轻车熟路游刃有余。

只是骑马再熟练，马匹行进时的颠簸总是难以避免的。
坐在马上的布兰妮颠簸晃动着，饶是尽力挺直端坐，身体却还是不免向李凯南滑去，最后更是直接滑进了他怀中。
李凯南穿着重型全身板甲，哪怕小姑娘都钻入怀中了，也感受不到什么软玉温香。
但小姑娘布兰妮和李凯南如此亲密接触，却是不免害羞得俏脸通红，仿佛下一刻就要化身蒸汽姬一般……
敏锐察觉到布兰妮身体的僵硬，李凯南意识到少女的害羞和难为情。
他有意转移布兰妮的注意力，便主动开口询问道：
“布兰妮，你外婆和你仔细提过那个被诅咒的城堡吗？”
已经彻底钻进李凯南怀中的布兰妮此时脸颊通红，眼神都因为害羞而变得水润迷离起来。
直到听到李凯南说话，她这才勉强回过神来。
“被诅咒的城堡吗……”
布兰妮点头道：
“我离开之前，外婆特意和我说过！”
“那里原本是卡佩王室一名亲王的城堡，后来亲王病逝，城堡被他的儿子所继承。”
“这位王子穷奢极欲，整日都在城堡中举办盛大的舞会，过着纸醉金迷的奢华生活。”
“直到某一个雨夜，有位路过的强大女巫想要以一朵玫瑰花为代价在他的城堡中借宿，被王子直接拒绝！”
content_en:
Before leaving Rip Forest with Britney, Grandma Britney specially gave her a small bag of gold coins.
And the old hunter also sent over a fine horse.
They had already determined in their hearts that he must be of noble blood, and they all felt that it was difficult for a bag of gold coins or a horse to impress Li Kainan.
However, at this time, Li Kainan had no followers following him, nor was he carrying any packages. Perhaps he was separated from his followers due to some accident.
So Li Kainan should need these things at this time...
Li Kainan also accepted all the things without courtesy.
He really needs these now, otherwise he wouldn't be able to provide even Britney's salary.
Li Kainan also asked the old hunter for a hunting bow and arrows in case of emergencies, and then he led Britney and set off together.
Following the old hunter's guidance, Li Kainan walked south and walked out of the forest, encountering the nearest small town.
However, Grandma Britney also specifically reminded Li Kainan not to go near the forest to the west of the town after arriving in the town.
Because there is a castle cursed by a witch...
When Li Kainan heard the news, he felt a little excited.
Needless to say, this kind of castle cursed by a witch sounds like some plot mission or dungeon!
Well, I'll go find out about it then.
If the level of the dungeon is not high, Li Kainan will definitely have to go in...
…
Since Britney can't ride a horse, the two of them rode a horse together when they left.
Li Kainan not only knows how to ride a horse, but he is also very good at it!
This is also his personal hobby. As a second-generation rich man with no ambitions, he even raised three horses specifically for him to practice horse fighting and horseback shooting before traveling through time...
So even with Britney, he seemed to be able to handle the horses with ease.
No matter how skilled you are in riding a horse, bumps when the horse is moving are always unavoidable.
Britney was jolting and swaying as she sat on the horse. Even though she tried her best to sit upright, her body still slid towards Li Kainan, and finally she slipped directly into his arms.
Li Kainan was wearing heavy full-body plate armor. Even if the little girl got into his arms, he could not feel the warm fragrance of nephrite.
But the little girl Britney and Li Kainan were so close to each other, but she couldn't help but blushed with shyness, as if she was about to transform into a Steam Queen in the next moment...
Keenly aware of Britney's stiffness, Li Kainan realized the girl's shyness and embarrassment.
He deliberately diverted Britney's attention, so he took the initiative to ask:
"Britney, has your grandma ever mentioned the cursed castle to you in detail?"
Britney, who had completely slipped into Li Kainan's arms, had flushed cheeks and her eyes were moist and blurred due to shyness.
It wasn't until she heard Li Kainan speak that she barely came back to her senses.
"A cursed castle..."
Britney nodded and said:
"Before I left, grandma specifically told me!"
"It was originally the castle of a prince of the Capetian royal family. Later, the prince died of illness and the castle was inherited by his son."
"This prince is extremely extravagant. He holds grand balls in the castle all day long and lives a luxurious life."
"Until one rainy night, a powerful witch passing by wanted to stay in his castle for the price of a rose, but the prince refused directly!"
